primary_program_definitions.text: (c) Subject to paragraph (13) of the form of ADR, each " ADS " evidenced by an ADR represents the right to receive one-third (1/3) of a Share and a pro rata share in any other Deposited Securities.
(l) " Shares " mean the class A common shares of the Company, and shall include the rights to receive Shares specified in paragraph (1) of the form of ADR.
Each ADS represents One-Third (1/3) of a Share CUSIP: AMERICAN DEPOSITARY RECEIPT evidencing AMERICAN DEPOSITARY SHARES representing CLASS A COMMON SHARES of TAL EDUCATION GROUP

independent_judgment: The primary Share alias means Class A common shares. Both the deposit entitlement and ADR face state one-third of that homogeneous ordinary/common share per ADS. This genuine F-6 Class A program must remain eligible when excluding preferred-stock and CPO-basket programs.
